notes.title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent English Version Out Now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/14b7458a8e9e786ffb09d43affc277dcb4e9ff3e.png

Gear up Adventurer!

Your adventure starts here, TODAY!

English support is finally here! The team at Acquire are happy to share with you the English release of Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent. We would like to take this opportunity to thank you all once again for the ongoing support you have shown for this game as we welcome our English-speaking adventurers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/7f68b5b3cc6491557d777dff7f51493c619b716e.png

The Continent of Pedra, home to the four nations, is slowly transforming into a labyrinth dungeon with monsters roaming the lands! Join Alex, Citrin and Lazuli as they fight and wander the entire island in search of the truth. Win? Lose? That all comes down to how YOU lead the charge! Summon and pick up your students and claim victory with your own hands!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/01f043def8aa17e7a29d3a4656585ff5c8cc346b.gif

Before you begin your journey why not try out our English Demo, also available now! We wish you well on your travels across the Continent of Pedra and we hope you enjoy Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/3430335ead0e4fc6fe3e99c0279abd4b72f7f5fe.png

notes.title: Adventure Academia News Article – English Release (Steam Feature)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/b83ea4cc9ef38809e8498ba16289d36074c14585.png
Greetings Fellow Adventurers!
Thank you for your continued support on Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent. We would like to bring you some updated news on the English release today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/526faeda0e34a63c3a09e84e02b7a6de519f1f8c.png

We are pleased to announce support for an English version of Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent, COMING SOON! Look out for further announcements in the coming weeks with more details and release dates.
Get ready for a super sneak peek ahead of release, as we are also very excited to announce the upcoming release of the English version of the demo! More news will be coming soon, so keep your eyes peeled for more updates on the demo release and pre-orders! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/205f3fc5713ca27d578ffa84bffc8e9b66e5f591.png
